 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**defines**" means to describe the nature or essential qualities of something. (परिभाषित करता है)
 
• The phrase **"the important intersection of time and place that defines who we are"** makes logical sense as it suggests that these factors shape or determine our identity.
 
• The other options: "**mends**," "**conceals**," and "**transports**" do not fit the context or convey the intended meaning.

**Complete Sentence:** The history of psychology tells us about the important intersection of time and place that **defines** who we are.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Mends (मरम्मत करना)**: means to repair or fix, not suitable in context.
 
• **Conceals (छिपाना)**: means to hide or keep something secret, also not suitable for the context.
 
• **Transports (लाना)**: means to move or carry from one place to another, also not fitting in the given sentence structure.
